subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue stay open as the cross-surface tracker, or should maintainers split/route it to a structured reply-metadata contract plus the durable final-fallback issue?
rationale: The remaining work spans Control UI request shape, Gateway protocol compatibility, agent runtime metadata, and final-delivery UX semantics; choosing the owner boundary is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Split Across Existing Owners
options.body: Use the reply-metadata PR or a maintainer replacement for the structured metadata half, keep no-output semantics on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after both halves are represented.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination umbrella until a maintainer-approved design covers both reply metadata and no-output UX together.

options.title: Defer Structured Reply Metadata
options.body: Treat Markdown quoting as sufficient for Control UI for now and keep only the final-fallback delivery contract active.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Owners
recommendation.body: Use the reply-metadata PR or a maintainer replacement for the structured metadata half, keep no-output semantics on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after both halves are represented.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main routing signal covers the Control UI send path, Gateway schema, and runtime-context boundary affected by the split/keep decision.
